title: Optimal Mean Reversion Trading with Transaction Costs and Stop-Loss Exit
venue: International Journal of Theoretical and Applied Finance, Vol. 18, No. 3, 2015
key_result: Entry/exit bands for OU spread; higher stop-loss implies lower optimal take-profit; entry region bounded above stop-loss
formula: Entry region [a̲, b̄]; exit at take-profit b*; b* decreases in stop-loss L

title: Stop-loss and Leverage in optimal Statistical Arbitrage with an application to Energy market
key_result: Long-run return as elementary function of stop-loss; optimal leverage from OU First-Exit-Times; extends Bertram (2009)
formula: μ_LR = f(L, θ, σ, c) where L = stop-loss level

title: Optimal order placement in limit order markets
key_result: Explicit convex-optimization solution for limit/market order split; closed form for single exchange
formula: min_x c(x) + λ·risk(x) s.t. fill-probability constraints; explicit split α* = f(reba te, spread, fill_prob)

title: Avellaneda-Stoikov and Cartea-Jaimungal as One Framework: A Forced Uniqueness Theorem for Inventory Market Making
key_result: A-S and C-J are the same model; φ = γσ²/2 forced by axioms; only one free parameter
formula: φ = γσ²/2; γ = 2φ/σ²; entropic certainty-equivalent on liquidation-adjusted terminal wealth

title: Dealing with the Inventory Risk. A solution to the market making problem
authors: Olivier Guéant, Charles-Albert Lehalle, Joaquin Fernandez Tapia
key_result: Optimal bid/ask quotes with exponential utility; arrival rates λ(δ)=Ae^(-kδ); skew linear in inventory
formula: δ± = 1/k ∓ γσ²q; λ(δ) = A e^(-kδ); HJB solved in closed form

title: Perpetual Futures for Stocks: The SpaceX Pre-IPO Market
key_result: Unified no-arbitrage: perp price = PV of benchmark flow discounted at funding rate; vol moves basis only via carry
formula: P_t = E[∫_t^∞ e^(-∫_t^s r_u du) B_s ds]; random time-change representation

title: Basis-Only Funding Is Not Dividend Fair: Settlement Design in Crypto Equity Perpetuals
authors: Donghwa Seo, Doohwi Cha, Seunghan Son, Juyeong Lee, Minsuk Sung, Minjae Lee
key_result: Premium-index funding cannot replicate dividends; fair-funding identity derived; two roles of funding split for equities
formula: E[funding_t] = carry_t + dividend_adjustment; optimal-stopping condition for timing fairness

title: Multi-asset optimal execution and statistical arbitrage strategies under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics
authors: Philippe Bergault, Fayçal Drissi, Olivier Guéant
key_result: Multi-asset OE with multivariate OU; cross-asset coupling changes liquidation schedule; exponential utility
formula: ∂_t u + L u - (1/(2γ))(∇u)ᵀ Σ⁻¹ ∇u = 0; HJB reduced via CARA ansatz

title: A singular stochastic control approach for optimal pairs trading with proportional transaction costs
key_result: Free boundary no-trade region from singular stochastic control; width ~√c; viscosity solution
formula: Free boundary problem equivalent to quasi-variational inequality; discrete DP converges

title: Optimal placement of a small order in a diffusive limit order book
authors: José E. Figueroa-López, Hyoeun Lee, Raghu Pasupathy
key_result: Critical time t₀: for t > t₀ with negative drift, optimal placement is deeper than best bid/ask
formula: t₀ ≈ function of drift, volatility, and fill-probability decay

title: Speculative Futures Trading under Mean Reversion
authors: Tim Leung, Jiao Li, Xin Li, Zheng Wang
key_result: Optimal double stopping for OU/CIR/XOU futures; explicit expected roll yield; entry/exit timing
formula: Roll yield = E[(F_{t+1} - F_t)/F_t]; optimal entry/exit from double stopping problem

title: Optimal market making
key_result: Unified market making framework generalizing A-S, Ho-Stoll, Cartea-Jaimungal; closed forms for exponential intensities
formula: General HJB: ∂_t u + μ∂_S u + ½σ²∂_SS u + sup_{δ^b,δ^a} [λ^b(δ^b)(δ^b + u(q+1) - u(q)) + λ^a(δ^a)(δ^a + u(q-1) - u(q))] = 0

title: Long- and short-time asymptotics of the first-passage time of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck and other mean-reverting processes
authors: R. J. Martin, M. J. Kearney, R. V. Craster
key_result: Single formula for OU first-passage time correct in both long- and short-time limits; asymptotic matching
formula: τ½ = ln(2)/θ; asymptotic matching via Hopf-Cole + Laplace transform

title: On the Profitability of Optimal Mean Reversion Trading Strategies
key_result: OU-calibrated pairs with Sharpe > 1.9 sustain OOS profitability; calibration window matters
formula: Sharpe = μ/σ annualized; OU parameters θ, μ, σ via MLE

title: Agent-Based Simulation of a Perpetual Futures Market
key_result: ABM reproduces perp-spot pegging; spread and order lifetime affect premium
